notes: This portable slice composes adapter-supplied application and update-rate FOM modules. A subject federate has one active object-class attribute subscription at an adapter-selected update-rate name and one active application interaction subscription; a separate requester names that subject using the inherited HLAfederate request parameter and subscribes to the three standard MIM report interactions. The test validates the object-class report's class count, handle, active indicator, update-rate name, and exact attribute list; the interaction report's active class/indicator pair; and the required empty directed-interaction NULL response. It does not cover passive subscriptions, multiple object classes or attributes, multiple update rates, DDM regions, empty ordinary subscription responses, populated directed subscriptions, or overall MOM conformance.

requirements.statement: The subject federate actively subscribes to the adapter-selected object-class attribute with the adapter-selected update-rate designator; the requester checks that the standard MIM report identifies that class, active state, update-rate name, and attribute handle.
The subject federate actively subscribes to the adapter-selected interaction class; the standard MIM subscription list must report exactly that class as active.
The requester sends HLArequestSubscriptions through the standard sendInteraction service and uses the inherited HLAfederate parameter to identify the joined subject whose subscriptions are queried.

The request names the joined subject through its inherited HLAfederate reference parameter and yields that subject's standard object-class and interaction subscription reports, plus the directed-interaction report. With no directed interactions subscribed, the latter is a NULL response with a zero class count, omitted object-class parameter, and empty interaction-class list. The test decodes reported class and attribute handles through public RTIambassador services and reads the standard active, update-rate, and subscription-list data elements.
